en.name: Shrimp and shellfish, frozen
en.summary: Frozen shrimp and shellfish keep 12–18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep them frozen and cook as directed. Once cooked, they keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage, and never thaw shellfish on the counter. Shrimp is a high-protein, low-acid food with very little connective tissue, so it both spoils fast and turns mushy fast once it warms. Anything left out is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) and follows the two-hour rule, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Most frozen shrimp is in fact already cooked or blanched, which makes careless thawing worse rather than better: there is no cooking step left to correct it.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once cooked, covered, which is what the published figure describes. Raw shrimp thawed in the fridge should be cooked the same day, kept in a sealed box on the bottom shelf and drained of any liquid that collects. Do not leave thawed shellfish sitting in melted ice water; it waterlogs the flesh and there is nothing you can do about the texture afterwards.
en.freezer: 12–18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. That is a quality window rather than a safety limit — shellfish held continuously at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely, and the useful test is the food, not the date: look for dry white patches, a chalky surface or a heavy crust of ice. Most shrimp is individually quick-frozen and lightly glazed with ice, which is protective rather than a cheat; keep the bag sealed with the air pressed out so the glaze does not sublime away.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight, or quickly in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter, never in warm water. Shrimp thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; anything thawed warm must not be refrozen.
spoilage: An ammonia smell, which is decisive for shellfish — discard it.
Dry white or yellowish frost-burned patches on the shells or the meat.
Black spots spreading on the shell and head end, or a chalky, cottony texture.
Shrimp welded into a solid block or a bag heavy with ice, meaning it part-thawed and refroze.
tips: Buy individually frozen pieces rather than a solid block where you can.
Thaw in a sealed bag under cold water when you are in a hurry — never warm water.
Cook just until the flesh turns opaque; shellfish goes rubbery in seconds.
Keep shells and heads for stock and freeze them separately.

faq.q: How long does frozen shrimp last?
faq.a: 12–18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe beyond that; the window is about texture and freezer burn.

faq.q: How do you thaw frozen shrimp quickly?
faq.a: In a sealed bag under cold running water, or overnight in the fridge. Never on the counter and never in warm water.

faq.q: How can you tell if frozen shrimp has gone bad?
faq.a: Smell it after thawing — any ammonia note means it goes in the bin. Chalky, cottony flesh or black spreading spots are also discard signals.

zh.name: 冷凍蝦與帶殼海鮮
zh.summary: 冷凍蝦與帶殼海鮮在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可保有最佳品質 12～18 個月。請保持冷凍並依指示烹調。煮熟之後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存，也絕對不要在檯面上退冰。蝦是高蛋白、低酸、結締組織又極少的食物，所以它既壞得快、回溫後也糊得快。任何擺在外面的都在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡，適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。而且市售冷凍蝦很多其實已經燙熟或汆燙過，這反而讓隨便退冰更危險：後面已經沒有一道加熱可以幫你補救了。
zh.fridge: 煮熟之後蓋好放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，公布的數字描述的正是這個狀態。在冷藏解凍的生蝦請當天煮掉，裝密封盒放最下層，並把積出來的水倒掉。不要讓解凍的海鮮一直泡在融化的冰水裡；肉會吸飽水，之後口感再也救不回來。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12～18 個月品質最好。那是品質期限而不是安全上限——全程維持在 −18 °C 的海鮮可以無限期保持安全，真正好用的判斷是看食物本身：乾白斑塊、表面粉粉的、或結了厚厚一層冰。多數冷凍蝦是單顆急凍再裹上一層薄冰衣，那是保護而不是偷斤減兩；請把袋子壓出空氣密封好，免得冰衣直接昇華掉。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋泡在流動冷水下快速解凍。絕對不要放檯面，也絕對不要泡溫水。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 聞到氨味——對海鮮來說這是決定性的，直接丟掉。
殼或蝦肉出現乾白、偏黃的凍燒斑塊。
殼和頭部出現擴散的黑點，或肉質變得粉粉的、像棉絮。
整包凍成一塊硬團或結滿厚冰，表示曾經半退冰又再凍。
tips: 盡量買單顆分離的急凍款，不要買凍成一大塊的。
趕時間就密封裝袋泡流動冷水——絕對不要用溫水。
煮到肉剛變不透明就好；海鮮變橡皮往往只差幾秒。
殼和頭留下來熬湯，另外分開冷凍。

faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12～18 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全；這個期限講的是口感和凍燒。

faq.q: 冷凍蝦要怎麼快速解凍？
faq.a: 密封裝袋泡流動冷水，或放冷藏隔夜。絕對不要放檯面，也不要泡溫水。
解凍後聞一下——只要有氨味就丟掉。肉質變得粉粉像棉絮，或黑點一直擴散，也都是該丟的訊號。
